notes.title: Triversal V2 Launch!
notes.notes:
[h2]Some big news!! We've launched Triversal V2! AND we're a part of Steam's Endless Replayability Fest![/h2]

[b]Here's a list of changes from V1 to V2![/b]
[list]
[*] Added new "Free Node" and "Quantum Node" puzzle elements
[*] Updated control scheme to facilitate interactions with new puzzle elements
[*] Implemented various visual updates
[*] Completely overhauled Puzzle Packs
[*] 27 new Puzzle-Pack-related achievements
[*] Redesigned Daily Puzzle boards and scoring
[*] Redesigned Standard Endurance Mode and Pro Endurance Mode
[*] Introduced Classic Endurance Mode to relive the v1 experience
[/list]
We also implemented cloud save which you can find out more about in a previous post: https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1481000/view/4115798034510920377?l=english 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39187483/aebabce7994e7cbd85249284cd6d718c60d5d8bb.gif[/img]

notes.title: Playtest for Women's Day Steam Sale 2024!
notes.notes:
We're so happy to participate in the Women's Day Steam Sale once again! The event is hosted by [url=https://twitter.com/wingsfundme]WINGS[/url], and runs from March 1 - 10, 2024. We can't wait to celebrate all the talented women in the games industry and [url=https://store.steampowered.com/sale/womenday24#supporters]check out the amazing games[/url] they've created! (*^ -^*)

We've made some updates for that we think you'll like but want to hear from you and finesse them a bit more before possibly making any changes SO we're super friggin thrilled to offer a free playtest for the duration of the event! 

ALSO, we're discounting the game by 60% for anyone who does want to pick up a copy! 

[h2]PLAYTEST DETAILS: [/h2]
[list]
[*] Free playtest will only be available from Mar 1-10, 2024.
[*] Open to all, just sign up on [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1481000/Triversal/]Triversal's Steam store page[/url] and you'll automatically be added!
[*] Please note that most game progress will NOT carry over to the main game but it will also NOT impact your current game save from the main game.
[*] The purpose of the playtest is to test out new elements that we want feedback on before we intend to possibly add to the main game as an update.
[*] If you [i]don't [/i]own the game, you will need to complete the tutorial first which explains the basic gameplay but does [i]not [/i] have an explainer for the new elements.
[*] Hints will pop up on their own the first time you encounter these elements.
[*] The best way to experience these new elements is through Sandbox mode at "Harder" levels.
[*] We support controller, but recommend using mouse for the playtest 
[/list]
[h3]New elements:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Quantum Nodes: These tricksy new nodes come in pairs. When one is pulled out of place, it's entangled pair moves in the opposite direction.
[*] Free Nodes:  Free nodes behave like flexible nodes, but can be freely connected and disconnected like the yellow sun token to any other element.
[*] New Controls: To make these new nodes possible we have shaken things up a bit in how you can connect and disconnect elements.  You now "tap and tap" each element you want to connect or "click and drag" with your mouse between them. We still have controller support, but both only the equivalent "tap and tap" input method is implemented, so use at your own risk. :D
[/list]
[h3]Main game explainer video prior to adding Quantum Nodes and Free Nodes[/h3]

notes.title: Steam Cloud Update
notes.notes:
You asked for it: Triversal now supports cloud save!

If you are a new user or have your progress saved on a single machine: Enjoy!

If you are an existing user or have multiple users on multiple machines: Also Enjoy! But if you are concerned about the BEST way to proceed with this update, read on.

WHAT'S CHANGED

Save data location has moved from being machine-user-specific (Local Data) to being Steam-user-specific (Steam Data). Save data contains information about theme preferences, game options, puzzle pack progress, high scores, and achievement progress. It does not contain information pertaining to Daily Challenge leaderboards.

The Local Data is stored in the old location:
%AppData%\..\LocalLow\Phantom Compass Inc_\Triversal\SaveData.dat
The Steam Data is stored in the new location (with {SteamID} representing the user's Steam ID):
%AppData%\..\LocalLow\Phantom Compass Inc_\Triversal\{SteamID}\SaveData.dat

To determine a specific user's Steam ID:
1. Open and sign into the Steam client.
2. In the top right, select the drop-down arrow next to the current user's display name, and select "Account details".
3. Find the current user's Steam ID displayed (as a usually 17-digit number) directly beneath the user's username at the top of this page.

By default, your Steam Data will automatically be copied from the Local Data present on the first machine used to launch and run the latest version of the game. If no data is available on that machine, then the Steam Data will be automatically created as if the user is launching the game for the first time.

WHAT TO DO

For users who play the game on a single non-shared machine:
1. Launch the game as normal on the machine you normally play on - your Local Data will automatically upgrade to Steam Data, and will then be synced to that account on all machines that you later play on.

For users playing on a machine with existing Local Data who want to start the game fresh:
1. Temporarily move the Local Data file out of the above old location before launching (and later exiting) the game on your account.
2. Verify the existence of your account's Steam Data at the above new location.
3. Return the original Local Data file to its original location, allowing other Steam users to generate Steam Data from it.

For users who have generated their Steam Data using Local Data from the wrong machine:
1. Sign in on the machine with the correct Local Data.
2. Perform a Steam Cloud sync (this can be triggered by signing in, then launching and exiting the game).
3. Copy the Local Data from the old Local Data location to the new Steam Data location corresponding to this user's account.
4. Launch the game again.
5. If prompted to resolve a Steam Cloud sync conflict, choose "Upload local files" to overwrite the incorrectly upgraded data.

notes.title: GWB Steam Sale
notes.notes:
We're very happy to announce that our spatial puzzle game, Triversal, will be participation in the GWB Steam event as a 2022 GWB Game Awards Finalist! AND it will be discounted by 70%! 

[h3]Game Details:[/h3]
Triversal is a perfect palette cleanser between intense tasks, whether you have a couple minutes or a couple hours to unwind. Just find the right combination and simply add and remove elastic tethers to pull the light orb so it lines up with the black hole. 

With the option to mix and match different music and visual styles, you can choose a mode of play to best suit your mood: Daily Puzzle, Endurance, Puzzle Packs, or Sandbox.

notes.notes:
A beta version of Triversal will be available through Steam Playtest May 12-31, 2021!

Triversal is a chill and satisfying spatial puzzle game that will launch with 4 modes of play and thousands of levels to suit you mood for challenge.

Easy to pick up and play: Find the right combination to suspend the glowy orb over the black hole with stretch tethers.

We would love to get feedback on our beta from as many players as possible before our launch on July 13th!  So spread the word and share what you think in "Suggestions and Feedback!"  

This game has support for Streamers too on any platform!  Let us know how it worked on your stream.
